Un processus distinct affine les exigences ; celui-ci existe afin de fournir une base concrète à affiner.

2511.title: Pourquoi il s’agit d’un sous-processus de l’édition
2511.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Il s’exécute à l’intérieur de la boucle d’édition, entre la réservation du bean et la rédaction de la modification — voir Édition et porte de validation IHM. Cet emplacement est précisément tout l’intérêt : les preuves sont recueillies avant que la phrase ne soit écrite, et non rassemblées après coup pour en appuyer une. Une recommandation d’abord rédigée puis étayée ensuite n’est qu’une recherche documentaire visant confirmation. L’ordre des étapes est précisément ce qui lui évite d’être cela. Il s’agit d’une activité d’appel (call activity), elle dispose donc de son propre fichier, de ses propres couloirs et de son propre diagramme, et le diagramme d’édition reste lisible. Elle n’a également rien à faire pour les contenus qui ne portent aucune recommandation — un folio de mathématiques n’en a aucune — et elle y est ignorée plutôt que satisfaite à vide.

2512.title: Le sous-processus
2512.content: ✎ Edit KG… . Quatre couloirs, car quatre types distincts d’acteurs sont impliqués et les confondre ferait perdre toute responsabilité : . | couloir | qui | est responsable de | . | Auteur / élaborateur de la directive | personne | le PICO, l’évaluation critique, la gradation | . | Agent de recherche de preuves | système | la recherche à travers les trois classes | . | Registres et observatoires de confiance | externe | la résolution effective d’une citation | . | Plan de travail — beans | partagé | chaque lacune et chaque citation non vérifiée | . Le troisième couloir est externe à dessein. L’autorité n’est pas quelque chose que le folio peut affirmer sur lui-même ; c’est un fait vérifié auprès de l’éditeur. Dessiner ce couloir à l’intérieur des limites du système ferait du caractère « faisant autorité » une auto-évaluation. Source BPMN 2.0 · SVG en taille réelle .

2513.title: La première étape regarde vers l’intérieur
2513.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . La première étape regarde vers l’intérieur, non vers l’extérieur. Avant toute recherche, l’auteur lit ce que le document, le DAK ou l’IG dit déjà sur cette question. Une nouvelle recommandation qui contredit une recommandation sœur dans le même artefact est un défaut qu’aucune quantité de preuves externes ne révélera — les sources peuvent toutes être impeccables et la directive demeurer incohérente. C’est aussi de loin l’étape la moins coûteuse, et c’est celle qui est le plus souvent omise.

2514.title: Formuler la question sous forme de PICO
2514.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Population, Intervention, Comparateur, Issue. L’élaboration de lignes directrices de l’OMS formule la question de cette façon avant toute recherche documentaire, et la raison tient à l’auditabilité plutôt qu’au cérémonial : sans PICO, « nous avons cherché des preuves » n’est pas une affirmation que quiconque puisse vérifier. Avec un PICO, la recherche est reproductible — un second lecteur peut l’exécuter et vérifier si le même corpus de preuves est obtenu. Le PICO est porté par la recommandation, et non abandonné après la recherche. C’est ce dont un lecteur ultérieur a besoin pour savoir si de nouvelles preuves concernent cette recommandation ou une recommandation différente.

2515.title: Trois classes de preuves, et non une seule
2515.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . La recherche se déploie à travers trois classes qui ne sont pas interchangeables, et les maintenir séparées est tout l’objet de la passerelle parallèle : . Sources de confiance — L1. Littérature primaire ingérée sous library/ : l’arborescence sections/*.md et, lorsqu’un document a été scanné, ocr/page-NNN.txt. Angle mort connu. Un document ayant fait l’objet d’un OCR mais n’ayant jamais été repassé dans pdf-structure.py n’a qu’un bouchon (stub) dans sections/, de sorte qu’une recherche limitée à sections le manque entièrement. Mesuré : 26 arborescences library/*/ocr/ contre 11 structure.json enregistrant "text_source": "ocr". Voir Ingestion de documents. Contenu de confiance — DAK L2, IG L3. Directives déjà arbitrées : Kits d’adaptation numérique SMART de l’OMS au niveau L2, Guides d’implémentation FHIR au niveau L3. Une recommandation adoptée dans un DAK publié constitue une preuve d’une nature différente d’une étude primaire — il s’agit d’une décision préalable, avec sa propre provenance et sa propre gradation — et doit être citée comme telle. La recycler en preuve primaire est le mode de défaillance que cette séparation a pour but d’empêcher. Dépôts de données et jeux de données statistiques. Séries d’indicateurs et microdonnées. Distincts une fois encore car l’unité de preuve est une mesure, à laquelle sont rattachées une population, une période et une méthode — non une affirmation en prose.

2516.title: Vérifier l’autorité, non l’affirmer
2516.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Chaque candidat est résolu par rapport à l’API standard de l’organisme qui le publie, de sorte que « faisant autorité » soit un fait résolu plutôt qu’une assertion dans une citation. Quatre éléments sont vérifiés : . | l’identifiant se résout auprès de l’éditeur ; | la notice récupérée correspond à ce que la citation affirme ; | la version et la date sont celles citées ; | l’éditeur est un éditeur que ce folio a déclaré de confiance. | . La vérification 2 est celle qui intercepte les véritables erreurs. Une citation peut se résoudre parfaitement et ne toujours pas dire ce que la phrase qui la cite affirme. Une citation impossible à résoudre n’est ni abandonnée ni conservée en silence. Elle devient un bean, de sorte que la lacune soit visible dans le plan de travail au lieu de subsister sous forme d’une note de bas de page que personne ne revérifie. Non tranché ici, et délibérément : la liste des registres, les points de terminaison (endpoints) et la structure de l’enregistrement d’autorité stocké. Ce conteneur n’ayant aucun accès au réseau sortant, aucun point de terminaison en deçà du niveau de « l’API propre de l’éditeur » n’a été vérifié, et en nommer de spécifiques reviendrait à consigner une supposition. C’est une question d’exigences, et un processus distinct y est consacré.

2517.title: Grader le corpus et enregistrer une lacune
2517.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . La gradation s’applique au corpus de preuves pour une question PICO donnée — c’est pourquoi l’évaluation critique se situe après la convergence et non au sein de la divergence. Une citation isolée ne porte pas d’évaluation de certitude ; un corpus de preuves répondant à une question en porte une. Vient ensuite une passerelle : est-ce suffisant pour une recommandation ? . Des preuves insuffisantes constituent un résultat en soi. Cela est consigné sous forme d’une lacune honnête que la directive peut expliciter — « les preuves ne soutiennent pas de recommandation ici » — au lieu d’être contourné en affaiblissant la recommandation jusqu’à ce que les preuves disponibles se trouvent par hasard la soutenir. Cette démarche est toujours possible et elle est toujours mauvaise, raison pour laquelle la branche « non » mène quelque part. Sur la branche « oui », le PICO, le corpus de preuves gradué et chaque citation vérifiée avec son enregistrement d’autorité résolu sont consignés sur le bloc de recommandation. Un lecteur peut alors remonter la chaîne depuis la phrase jusqu’à la source.

2518.title: Ce qui n’est pas construit
2518.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Tout ce qui suit est absent, et non partiellement fonctionnel. Le diagramme est une modélisation du processus envisagé ; voici les parties qui ne s’appuient sur aucun code. |   | état | . | la liste des registres de confiance | non arrêtée | . | liaisons d’API des observatoires | non écrites ; aucun point de terminaison vérifié depuis ce conteneur | . | le schéma de l’enregistrement d’autorité | non conçu | . | le système de gradation qu’un folio déclare | non choisi | . | une compétence evidence-retrieval | n’existe pas — le diagramme la nomme, rien ne l’implémente | . | champs PICO sur un bloc de recommandation | absents du schéma | . Le fait que le diagramme mentionne une compétence inexistante est délibéré et suit la même convention que celle adoptée par les diagrammes d’ingestion : le modèle indique ce qui implémenterait une étape, et l’écart entre le modèle et le code est ainsi visible au lieu d’être dissimulé.

2520.title: Evidencia para una recomendación
2520.content: TR . En esta página . | Por qué este es un subproceso de edición | El subproceso | El primer paso mira hacia adentro | Formulación de la pregunta como PICO | Tres clases de evidencia, no una | Verificar la autoridad, no afirmarla | Gradación del cuerpo de evidencia y registro de una brecha | Qué no está construido | . Esta página se genera a partir de content/docs/evidence/ — cada sección a continuación enlaza a su propia fuente. ✎ Edit QA… TR . Cómo obtiene su evidencia una recomendación en una directriz: quién busca, dónde busca y qué hace que una fuente sea autorizada en lugar de simplemente citada. PROPUESTA BASE (STRAWPERSON). La forma del proceso a continuación es real, se renderiza y supera la compuerta de políticas del flujo de trabajo. Lo que deliberadamente no está definido aquí: qué registros se consideran de confianza, qué sistema de gradación declara un folio y cómo se vinculan las API de los observatorios. Un proceso independiente refina los requisitos; esto existe para que haya algo concreto que refinar.

2521.title: Por qué este es un subproceso de edición
2521.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Se ejecuta dentro del bucle de edición, entre reclamar el bean y redactar el cambio — consulta Edición y la compuerta de validación de HCI. Esa posición es la clave de todo: la evidencia se recopila antes de escribir la oración, no se reúne después para respaldarla. Una recomendación redactada primero y respaldada con evidencia después es una búsqueda bibliográfica orientada a la confirmación. El orden de los pasos es lo que evita que sea eso. Es una actividad de llamada (call activity), por lo que tiene su propio archivo, sus propios carriles y su propio diagrama, y el diagrama de edición se mantiene legible. Tampoco tiene nada que hacer con contenidos que no contienen recomendaciones —un folio de matemáticas no tiene ninguna— y allí se omite en lugar de satisfacerse de forma vacua.

2522.title: El subproceso
2522.content: ✎ Edit KG… . Cuatro carriles, porque participan cuatro tipos distintos de actores y confundirlos es la forma en que se pierde la rendición de cuentas: . | carril | quién | es responsable de | . | Autor / desarrollador de directrices | persona | la pregunta PICO, la evaluación, la gradación | . | Agente de evidencia | sistema | la recuperación a través de las tres clases | . | Registros y observatorios de confianza | externo | si una cita se resuelve | . | Plan de trabajo — beans | compartido | cada brecha y cada cita no verificada | . El tercer carril es externo a propósito. La autoridad no es algo que el folio pueda atribuirse a sí mismo; es un hecho comprobado en la entidad publicadora. Trazar ese carril dentro de los límites del sistema convertiría «autorizada» en una autoevaluación. Fuente BPMN 2.0 · SVG a tamaño completo .

2523.title: El primer paso mira hacia adentro
2523.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . El primer paso mira hacia adentro, no hacia afuera. Antes de cualquier búsqueda, el autor lee lo que el documento, DAK o IG ya dice sobre esta cuestión. Una nueva recomendación que contradiga una recomendación hermana en el mismo artefacto es un defecto que ninguna cantidad de evidencia externa revelará: las fuentes pueden ser todas impecables y la directriz seguir siendo incoherente. Este es también, con diferencia, el paso más económico, y es el que se omite con mayor frecuencia.

2524.title: Formulación de la pregunta como PICO
2524.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Población, Intervención, Comparador, Resultado. El desarrollo de directrices de la OMS plantea la pregunta de esta manera antes de cualquier recuperación, y la razón es la auditabilidad más que el formalismo: sin un PICO, «buscamos evidencia» no es una afirmación que cualquiera pueda comprobar. Con él, la búsqueda es reproducible: un segundo lector puede ejecutarla y determinar si se obtiene el mismo cuerpo de evidencia. La estructura PICO se conserva en la recomendación, no se descarta después de la búsqueda. Es lo que un lector posterior necesita para saber si la nueva evidencia afecta a esta recomendación o a una diferente.

2525.title: Tres clases de evidencia, no una
2525.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . La recuperación se ramifica en tres clases que no son intercambiables, y mantenerlas separadas es el propósito de la compuerta paralela: . Fuentes de confianza — L1. Literatura primaria ingerida bajo library/: el árbol sections/*.md y, donde un documento fue escaneado, ocr/page-NNN.txt. Punto ciego conocido. Un documento que pasó por OCR pero que nunca se volvió a procesar mediante pdf-structure.py tiene solo un fragmento provisional (stub) en sections/, por lo que una búsqueda exclusiva en sections se lo pierde por completo. Medición: 26 árboles library/*/ocr/ frente a 11 structure.json que registran "text_source": "ocr". Consulta Ingesta de documentos. Contenido de confianza — DAK L2, IG L3. Directrices ya adjudicadas: Kits de Adaptación Digital SMART de la OMS en L2, Guías de Implementación FHIR en L3. Una recomendación adoptada en un DAK publicado es evidencia de un tipo diferente al de un estudio primario —es una decisión previa, con su propia procedencia y su propia gradación— y debe citarse como tal. Hacerla pasar por evidencia primaria es el modo de fallo que esta separación existe para prevenir. Repositorios de datos y conjuntos de datos estadísticos. Series de indicadores y microdatos. Diferenciados una vez más porque la unidad de evidencia es una medición con una población, un período y un método asociados —no una afirmación en prosa.

2526.title: Verificar la autoridad, no afirmarla
2526.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Cada candidato se resuelve frente a la API estándar del organismo que lo publica, de modo que «autorizada» sea un hecho comprobado y no una mera afirmación en una cita. Se verifican cuatro cosas: . | el identificador se resuelve en la entidad publicadora; | el registro recuperado coincide con lo que la cita afirma; | la versión y fecha son las citadas; | la entidad publicadora es una que este folio ha declarado de confianza. | . La comprobación 2 es la que detecta los errores reales. Una cita puede resolverse a la perfección y aun así no decir lo que la oración que la cita afirma. Una cita que no se puede resolver ni se descarta ni se conserva en silencio. Se convierte en un bean, de modo que la brecha sea visible en el plan de trabajo en lugar de perdurar como una nota al pie que nadie vuelve a comprobar. No definido aquí, y de manera deliberada: la lista de registros, los extremos (endpoints) y la estructura del registro de autoridad almacenado. Este contenedor no tiene red saliente, por lo que ningún endpoint por debajo del nivel de «la propia API del publicador» ha sido verificado, y nombrar algunos específicos sería registrar una conjetura. Esa es una cuestión de requisitos, y existe un proceso independiente para ello.

2527.title: Gradación del cuerpo de evidencia y registro de una brecha
2527.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . La gradación se asigna al cuerpo de evidencia para una pregunta PICO determinada —razón por la cual la evaluación se sitúa tras la convergencia y no dentro de la ramificación. Una sola cita no posee una calificación de certeza; un cuerpo de evidencia que responde a una pregunta, sí. Luego, una compuerta: ¿es esto suficiente para una recomendación? . La evidencia insuficiente es un resultado. Se registra como una brecha honesta que la directriz puede declarar —«la evidencia no respalda una recomendación en este punto»— en lugar de resolverse debilitando la recomendación hasta que la evidencia disponible casualmente la respalde. Esa maniobra siempre está disponible y siempre es errónea, razón por la cual la rama «no» tiene un destino al que dirigirse. En la rama «sí», la formulación PICO, el cuerpo de evidencia con su gradación y cada cita verificada con su registro de autoridad resuelto se escriben en el bloque de recomendación. Un lector puede entonces reconstruir la cadena desde la oración hasta la fuente original.

2528.title: Qué no está construido
2528.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Todo lo que figura a continuación está ausente, no funcionando parcialmente. El diagrama es un modelo del proceso previsto; estas son las partes que no tienen código que las respalde. |   | estado | . | la lista de registros de confianza | no decidida | . | vinculaciones con la API de observatorios | no escritas; ningún extremo (endpoint) verificado desde este contenedor | . | el esquema del registro de autoridad | no diseñado | . | el sistema de gradación que declara un folio | no elegido | . | una habilidad evidence-retrieval | no existe — el diagrama la nombra, nada la implementa | . | campos PICO en un bloque de recomendación | no están en el esquema | . Que el diagrama mencione una habilidad que no existe es deliberado y sigue la misma convención que utilizan los diagramas de ingesta: el modelo indica qué implementaría un paso, y la brecha entre el modelo y el código se hace visible en lugar de ocultarse.

2530.title: 推荐的证据
2530.content: TR . 本页目录 . | 为什么这是编辑的一个子流程 | 子流程 | 第一步是向内审视 | 将问题构建为 PICO | 三类证据，而非单一类别 | 验证权威性，而非自称权威 | 对证据体进行分级并记录缺口 | 尚未构建的内容 | . 本页面生成自 content/docs/evidence/ — 下方每个小节都链接至其自身的源文件。 . ✎ Edit QA… TR . 指南中的推荐意见如何获取其证据——由谁检索、去何处检索，以及是什么让一个来源具有权威性（authoritative）而不仅仅是被引用。 . 草案原型（STRAWPERSON）。 下方的流程形态是真实的，能够正常渲染并通过工作流策略关卡。此处特意未予确定的事项包括：哪些注册库（registries）算作受信任的、folio 声明哪种分级系统，以及观察台（observatory）API 如何绑定。具体需求由一个单独的流程进行细化；设立本草案是为了提供可供细化的具体载体。 .

2531.title: 为什么这是编辑的一个子流程
2531.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . 它在编辑循环内部运行，位于认领 bean 与起草变更之间——参见编辑与 HCI 验证关卡。处于这一位置正是其核心要义所在：证据是在撰写语句之前收集的，而不是在事后拼凑以支持该语句。 . 先起草推荐意见、后寻找证据的做法，不过是为了寻求证实的文献检索。而正是步骤的先后顺序使其避免沦为这种做法。 . 它是一个调用活动（call activity），因此拥有自己的文件、自己的泳道以及自己的流程图，从而使编辑流程图保持清晰易读。对于不包含任何推荐意见的内容（例如数学 folio 中没有任何推荐意见），它也无需执行任何操作，在此类情况下直接跳过，而非流于形式地空泛满足。 .

2532.title: 子流程
2532.content: ✎ Edit KG… . 划分为四个泳道，是因为涉及四种不同类型的参与者，而将它们混为一谈正是问责机制失效的根源： . | 泳道 | 参与者 | 职责归属 | . | 作者 / 指南制定者 | 人工 | PICO、评价、分级 | . | 证据智能体 | 系统 | 跨三类来源的检索 | . | 受信任的注册库与观察台 | 外部 | 引用能否解析 | . | 工作计划 — beans | 共享 | 每一个缺口与每一条未验证的引用 | . 第三个泳道特意设为外部。权威性不是 folio 自身能够声称的属性；它是在发布机构处解析确立的事实。如果将该泳道画在系统边界之内，就会使“权威性”沦为一种自我评估。 . BPMN 2.0 source · full-size SVG .

2533.title: 第一步是向内审视
2533.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . 第一步是向内审视，而非向外寻找。 . 在进行任何检索之前，作者应先阅读文档、DAK 或 IG 对该问题已有的表述。同一制品中与同级推荐意见相冲突的新推荐意见是一种缺陷，任何外部证据都无法揭示这一点——即使来源无懈可击，指南本身依然可能自相矛盾、条理不清。 . 这无疑也是成本最低的一步，却最常被跳过。 .

2534.title: 将问题构建为 PICO
2534.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . 研究人群（Population）、干预措施（Intervention）、对照（Comparator）、结局（Outcome）。 . 在开展任何检索之前，WHO 指南制定都以这种方式表述问题，其原因在于可审计性而非走过场：没有 PICO，“我们寻找了证据”就不是任何人都能够核验的声明。而有了 PICO，检索便具有可重现性——另一位读者也可以运行相同的检索，并确认是否能获得相同的证据体。 . PICO 会保留在推荐意见上，而不是在检索结束后就被丢弃。后来的读者正是据此判断新的证据是与本条推荐意见相关，还是针对另一条不同的推荐意见。 .

2535.title: 三类证据，而非单一类别
2535.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . 检索扇出至三个不可互换的类别，而将它们区分开来正是并行网关的用意所在： . 受信任的来源 — L1。 library/ 下已摄入的原始文献：sections/*.md 目录树，以及扫描文档对应的 ocr/page-NNN.txt。 . 已知盲点。 经过 OCR 处理但从未通过 pdf-structure.py 重新运行的文档在 sections/ 中只有一个存根（stub），因此仅针对 sections 的检索会完全漏掉它。实测数据：26 个 library/*/ocr/ 树，而记录 "text_source": "ocr" 的 structure.json 仅有 11 个。参见文档摄入。 . 受信任的内容 — L2 DAK、L3 IG。 已经过裁定的指南：L2 的 WHO SMART 数字化适应包（DAK），以及 L3 的 FHIR 实施指南（IG）。在已发布的 DAK 中采用的推荐意见属于另一种不同类型的证据，不同于一手原始研究——它是一项先验决定（prior decision），拥有其自身的溯源与分级——且必须作为此类决定予以引用。将其洗白包装为一手证据，正是这一区分旨在防止的失效模式。 . 数据存储库与统计数据集。 指标序列和微观数据。这一点同样截然不同，因为证据的单元是附加了人群、时期和方法的测量值（measurement）——而非散文形式的陈述声明。 .

2536.title: 验证权威性，而非自称权威
2536.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . 每个候选证据都会对照发布它的机构的标准 API 进行解析，使得“权威性”成为一项解析确立的事实，而非引用中的主观断言。具体检查四项内容： . | 标识符在发布机构处能够成功解析； | 检索到的记录与引用所声明的内容相符； | 版本和日期与所引用的相一致； | 发布机构已被当前 folio 声明为受信任。 | . 检查项 2 能够捕获真正的错误。一个引用可能完全可以成功解析，但其内容却根本不支持引用它的那句话。 . 无法解析的引用既不会被丢弃，也不会被默不作声地保留。它会转化为一个 bean，以便在工作计划中显式暴露这一缺口，而不是作为无人重新核对的脚注苟存下来。 . 此处特意未予确定的事项：注册库列表、端点以及存储的权威记录的数据结构（shape）。由于此容器没有出站网络，因此在“发布机构自身 API”层级之下的具体端点均未经验证，列举具体端点无异于胡乱猜测。这是一个需求问题，会有单独的流程来处理它。 .

2537.title: 对证据体进行分级并记录缺口
2537.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . 等级附着于针对单个 PICO 问题的证据体（body of evidence）之上——这正是评价环节位于汇聚之后而非扇出内部的原因。单个引用不承载确定性评级；回答某个问题的整个证据体才承载评级。 . 随后是一个网关：这是否足以形成一条推荐意见？ . 证据不足本身就是一项成果。它被记录为指南可以诚实陈述的缺口——“现有证据在此不支持形成推荐意见”——而不是通过不断削弱推荐意见的措辞，直到现有证据刚好能够支持它为止来敷衍闭环。这种妥协手段随时可用，但永远是错误的，这也是为什么“否”分支有明确去向的原因。 . 在“是”分支上，PICO、完成分级的证据体，以及每条带有已解析权威记录的已验证引用，都会写入推荐意见块。读者随后便可沿着这条链条，从最终语句一路回溯至原始来源。 .

2538.title: 尚未构建的内容
2538.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . 以下所有内容目前均为缺失状态，而非部分可用。流程图是预期流程的模型；以下则是尚无代码支撑的部分。 . |   | 状态 | . | 受信任的注册库列表 | 尚未决定 | . | 观察台 API 绑定 | 尚未编写；未从此容器验证过任何端点 | . | 权威记录的模式（schema） | 尚未设计 | . | folio 声明的分级系统 | 尚未选定 | . | evidence-retrieval 技能 | 尚不存在——流程图命名了它，但尚无实现代码 | . | 推荐意见块上的 PICO 字段 | 尚未纳入模式中 | . 流程图中命名尚不存在的技能是特意为之，与摄入流程图所遵循的惯例相同：模型说明了理应由什么来实现该步骤，而模型与代码之间的差距是清晰可见的，而非被隐瞒掩盖。 .

2540.title: Доказательства для рекомендации
2540.content: TR . На этой странице . | Почему это подпроцесс редактирования | Подпроцесс | Первый шаг обращен внутрь | Формулирование вопроса в формате PICO | Три класса доказательств вместо одного | Проверка авторитетности вместо её декларирования | Градация массива доказательств и фиксация пробелов | Что еще не реализовано | . Эта страница сгенерирована из content/docs/evidence/ — каждый раздел ниже ссылается на собственный исходный файл. ✎ Edit QA… TR . Как рекомендация в руководстве получает свои доказательства — кто ищет, где ищут и что делает источник авторитетным, а не просто процитированным. ПРЕДВАРИТЕЛЬНЫЙ ПРОЕКТ (STRAWPERSON). Форма процесса ниже реальна, корректно отрисовывается и проходит шлюз политик рабочего процесса. Что намеренно здесь не определено: какие реестры считаются доверенными, какую систему оценки (grading) объявляет фолио и как привязаны API обсерваторий. Уточнением требований занимается отдельный процесс; этот проект существует для того, чтобы было что-то конкретное для доработки.

2541.title: Почему это подпроцесс редактирования
2541.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Он выполняется внутри цикла редактирования, между взятием bean в работу и подготовкой черновика изменения — см. Редактирование и шлюз валидации HCI. Эта позиция и есть самое главное: доказательства собираются до того, как предложение написано, а не подбираются постфактум для его обоснования. Рекомендация, сначала сформулированная, а затем подкрепленная доказательствами, — это поиск литературы ради подтверждения заранее принятого решения. Именно порядок шагов предотвращает это. Это call activity (вызываемый процесс), поэтому у него собственный файл, собственные дорожки (lanes) и своя диаграмма, а диаграмма редактирования остается легко читаемой. Кроме того, ему нечего делать с контентом, не содержащим рекомендаций (в математическом фолио их нет), и там он просто пропускается, вместо того чтобы выполняться формально при отсутствии предмета (vacuously satisfied).

2542.title: Подпроцесс
2542.content: ✎ Edit KG… . Четыре дорожки (lanes), поскольку задействованы четыре различных типа участников, а их смешение — верный способ потерять ответственность: . | дорожка | кто | за что отвечает | . | Автор / разработчик руководства | человек | PICO, критическая оценка (appraisal), градация (grade) | . | Агент доказательств (Evidence agent) | система | поиск по трем классам источников | . | Доверенные реестры и обсерватории | внешний участник | разрешается ли ссылка на цитату (resolves) | . | План работы — beans | общий ресурс | каждый пробел и каждая неверифицированная цитата | . Третья дорожка намеренно вынесена вовне. Авторитетность — это не то, что фолио может заявить о себе само; это факт, подтверждаемый у издателя. Проведение этой дорожки внутри границ системы превратило бы «авторитетность» в самооценку. Исходный код BPMN 2.0 · полноразмерный SVG .

2543.title: Первый шаг обращен внутрь
2543.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Первый шаг направлен внутрь, а не наружу. До начала любого поиска автор изучает, что документ, DAK или IG уже говорят по данному вопросу. Новая рекомендация, противоречащая соседней рекомендации в том же артефакте, является дефектом, который невозможно выявить никакими внешними доказательствами: все внешние источники могут быть безупречны, но само руководство при этом останется внутренне противоречивым. Кроме того, это безусловно самый незатратный шаг, и именно его пропускают чаще всего.

2544.title: Формулирование вопроса в формате PICO
2544.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Популяция, Вмешательство, Сравнение, Исход (Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome). Разработка руководств ВОЗ формулирует вопрос именно таким образом перед началом любого поиска, и причина кроется в аудируемости, а не в формализме: без PICO утверждение «мы искали доказательства» невозможно проверить. При наличии PICO поиск воспроизводим: другой читатель может повторить его и проверить, возвращается ли тот же самый массив доказательств. PICO сохраняется в самой рекомендации, а не отбрасывается после завершения поиска. Именно это понадобится будущему читателю, чтобы понять, относятся ли новые доказательства к данной рекомендации или к какой-то другой.

2545.title: Три класса доказательств вместо одного
2545.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Поиск распараллеливается по трем классам, которые не являются взаимозаменяемыми, и разделение их между собой — главная задача параллельного шлюза: . Доверенные источники — L1. Загруженная первичная литература в каталоге library/: дерево sections/*.md и, если документ был отсканирован, ocr/page-NNN.txt. Известная слепая зона. Документ, прошедший OCR, но повторно не обработанный через pdf-structure.py, содержит лишь заглушку в sections/, поэтому поиск только по разделам полностью упускает его из виду. Измеренные показатели: 26 деревьев library/*/ocr/ против 11 файлов structure.json, содержащих запись "text_source": "ocr". См. Загрузка документов. Доверенный контент — L2 DAK, L3 IG. Уже утвержденные руководства: комплекты цифровой адаптации ВОЗ SMART Digital Adaptation Kits на уровне L2, руководства по внедрению FHIR Implementation Guides на уровне L3. Рекомендация, принятая в опубликованном DAK, представляет собой доказательство иного рода, нежели первичное исследование: это ранее принятое решение, со своим происхождением и собственной градацией, и цитировать ее следует именно в этом качестве. Превращение («отмывание») таких решений в первичные доказательства — это критический сбой процесса, для предотвращения которого и введено данное разделение. Репозитории данных и статистические наборы данных. Ряды показателей и микроданные. Отличаются тем, что единицей доказательства здесь является измерение с привязанными к нему популяцией, временным периодом и методологией, а не утверждение в тексте.

2546.title: Проверка авторитетности вместо её декларирования
2546.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Каждый кандидат проверяется через стандартный API опубликовавшей его организации, благодаря чему статус «авторитетный» становится установленным фактом, а не утверждением в цитате. Проверяются четыре вещи: . | идентификатор успешно разрешается (resolves) на стороне издателя; | полученная запись соответствует тому, что утверждается в цитате; | версия и дата совпадают с процитированными; | издатель входит в число тех, кого данное фолио объявило доверенными. | . Именно проверка 2 выявляет реальные ошибки. Ссылка в цитате может идеально разрешаться, но при этом источник вовсе не говорит то, о чем сказано в ссылающемся на него предложении. Неразрешимая цитата не отбрасывается и не сохраняется молча. Она превращается в bean, благодаря чему пробел остается видимым в плане работы, а не оседает сноской, которую никто больше не проверяет. Намеренно не определено здесь: список реестров, эндпоинты и структура сохраняемой записи об авторитетности. Этот контейнер не имеет доступа к внешней сети, поэтому ни один эндпоинт уровнем ниже «собственного API издателя» не проверялся, а перечисление конкретных адресов было бы просто догадкой. Это вопрос формирования требований, и для него существует отдельный процесс.

2547.title: Градация массива доказательств и фиксация пробелов
2547.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Градация (grade) присваивается совокупности (body) доказательств по одному вопросу PICO — именно поэтому оценка (appraisal) находится после объединения потоков, а не внутри этапа параллельного поиска. Отдельная цитата не несет в себе рейтинга определенности; им обладает массив доказательств, отвечающий на поставленный вопрос. Затем следует шлюз: достаточно ли этого для выработки рекомендации? . Недостаточность доказательств — это тоже результат. Она фиксируется как честный пробел, о котором руководство может прямо заявить: «имеющиеся доказательства не позволяют сформировать рекомендацию по данному вопросу», вместо того чтобы закрывать проблему ослаблением формулировки рекомендации до тех пор, пока имеющиеся доказательства случайно ей не подойдут. Такой маневр возможен всегда, и он всегда ошибочен, именно поэтому для ветки «нет» предусмотрен четкий маршрут. В ветке «да» вопрос PICO, оцененный массив доказательств и каждая верифицированная цитата с подтвержденной записью об авторитетности записываются в блок рекомендации. После этого читатель может проследить всю цепочку от конкретного предложения вплоть до первоисточника.

2548.title: Что еще не реализовано
2548.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . Все перечисленное ниже полностью отсутствует, а не работает частично. Диаграмма представляет собой модель целевого процесса; ниже указаны части, за которыми пока нет программного кода. |   | состояние | . | список доверенных реестров | не определен | . | привязки API обсерваторий | не написаны; ни один эндпоинт не проверялся из этого контейнера | . | схема записи об авторитетности | не спроектирована | . | система оценки (grading), объявляемая фолио | не выбрана | . | навык evidence-retrieval | не существует — на диаграмме он указан, но ничто его не реализует | . | поля PICO в блоке рекомендации | отсутствуют в схеме | . Указание на диаграмме еще не существующего навыка сделано намеренно и следует тому же соглашению, что и диаграммы загрузки (ingestion): модель описывает то, что должно было бы реализовывать шаг, благодаря чему разрыв между моделью и реальным кодом остается видимым, а не скрытым.

2550.title: الأدلة للتوصية
2550.content: TR . في هذه الصفحة . | لماذا تُعد هذه عملية فرعية من التحرير | العملية الفرعية | الخطوة الأولى تتجه للداخل | صياغة السؤال وفق نموذج PICO | ثلاث فئات من الأدلة، لا فئة واحدة | التحقق من الموثوقية، لا مجرد ادعائها | تقييم مجمل الأدلة، وتسجيل الفجوات | ما لم يتم بناؤه بعد | . تم توليد هذه الصفحة من content/docs/evidence/ — يرتبط كل قسم أدناه بمصدره الخاص. ✎ Edit QA… TR . كيف تحصل توصية في دليل إرشادي على أدلتها — مَن يبحث، وأين يبحث، وما الذي يجعل المصدر موثوقًا (authoritative) بدلاً من كونه مجرد مصدر مقتبس. مسودة مبدئية (STRAWPERSON). إن شكل العملية الموضح أدناه حقيقي، ويُعرض تصييريًا، ويجتاز بوابة سياسة سير العمل. ما تم تركه عمدًا دون حسم هنا: أي السجلات تُعد موثوقة، وأي نظام تقييم يعلنه الـ folio، وكيفية ربط واجهات برمجة التطبيقات (APIs) للمراصد. هناك عملية منفصلة لتنقيح المتطلبات؛ وهذا النموذج موجود ليكون هناك شيء ملموس يمكن تنقيحه.

2551.title: لماذا تُعد هذه عملية فرعية من التحرير
2551.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . تعمل هذه العملية داخل حلقة التحرير، بين حجز الـ bean وصياغة التغيير — انظر التحرير وبوابة التحقق من التفاعل البشري الحاسوبي (HCI). وهذا الموضع هو جوهر الأمر برمته: يتم جمع الأدلة قبل كتابة الجملة، لا تجميعها لاحقًا لدعم ما كُتب. إن صياغة التوصية أولاً ثم البحث عن أدلة لها ثانيًا ليست سوى بحث في المنشورات بهدف التأكيد. وترتيب الخطوات هو ما يمنع ذلك. وهي عبارة عن نشاط استدعاء (call activity)، لذا فإن لها ملفها الخاص ومساراتها الخاصة ومخططها الخاص، مما يحافظ على وضوح مخطط التحرير وقابليته للقراءة. كما أنه لا يوجد ما تفعله في المحتوى الذي لا يتضمن أي توصيات — إذ لا يحتوي folio الرياضيات على أي منها — ويتم تخطيها هناك بدلاً من استيفائها بشكل شكلي فارغ.

2552.title: العملية الفرعية
2552.content: ✎ Edit KG… . أربعة مسارات، لأن هناك أربعة أنواع مختلفة من الجهات الفاعلة تشارك في العملية، والخلط بينها هو ما يضيع المسؤولية: . | المسار | مَن | يملك | . | المؤلف / مطور الدليل الإرشادي | شخص | صياغة PICO، والتقييم، والدرجة | . | وكيل الأدلة | نظام | الاسترجاع عبر الفئات الثلاث | . | السجلات والمراصد الموثوقة | جهة خارجية | تحديد ما إذا كان الاقتباس يُحلّ | . | خطة العمل — beans | مشترك | كل فجوة وكل اقتباس غير مؤكد | . المسار الثالث خارجي عن عمد. فالموثوقية ليست شيئًا يمكن للـ folio أن يؤكده عن نفسه؛ بل هي حقيقة يتم التحقق منها لدى جهة النشر. ورسم ذلك المسار داخل حدود النظام كان سيجعل “الموثوقية” مجرد تقييم ذاتي. مصدر BPMN 2.0 · ملف SVG بالحجم الكامل .

2553.title: الخطوة الأولى تتجه للداخل
2553.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . الخطوة الأولى تنظر إلى الداخل، لا إلى الخارج. قبل أي بحث، يقرأ المؤلف ما يذكره المستند أو DAK أو IG بالفعل حول هذا السؤال. فتوصية جديدة تتناقض مع توصية شقيقة في نفس المخرج هي عيب لن تكشفه أي كمية من الأدلة الخارجية — فقد تكون المصادر كلها لا تشوبها شائبة ويبقى الدليل الإرشادي غير مترابط. هذه أيضًا هي أرخص خطوة على الإطلاق، ومع ذلك فهي الخطوة الأكثر تخطيًا في أغلب الأحيان.

2554.title: صياغة السؤال وفق نموذج PICO
2554.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . المجتمع، التدخل، المقارن، النتيجة (Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome). تحدد عملية تطوير الدلائل الإرشادية لمنظمة الصحة العالمية السؤال بهذه الطريقة قبل أي استرجاع، والسبب في ذلك هو قابلية التدقيق لا مجرد اتباع للشكليات: فبدون PICO، لا تُعد عبارة “لقد بحثنا عن أدلة” ادعاءً يمكن لأي شخص التحقق منه. ولكن بوجودها، يصبح البحث قابلاً للتكرار — حيث يمكن لقارئ ثانٍ تشغيله وتحديد ما إذا كان نفس مجمل الأدلة سيظهر مجددًا. يُحفظ نموذج PICO مع التوصية ولا يتم التخلص منه بعد انتهاء البحث؛ فهو ما يحتاجه أي قارئ لاحق لمعرفة ما إذا كانت الأدلة الجديدة تتعلق بهذه التوصية بعينها أم بتوصية أخرى.

2555.title: ثلاث فئات من الأدلة، لا فئة واحدة
2555.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . يتفرع الاسترجاع عبر ثلاث فئات غير قابلة للتبادل، والفصل بينها هو الغاية من البوابة المتوازية: . مصادر موثوقة — L1. الأدبيات الأساسية المستوعبة تحت library/: شجرة sections/*.md، وحيثما تم مسح المستند ضوئيًا، ocr/page-NNN.txt. نقطة عمياء معروفة. المستند الذي أُجري له تعرف ضوئي على الحروف (OCR) دون إعادة تشغيله عبر pdf-structure.py يمتلك فقط عنصرًا بدائيًا في sections/، وبالتالي فإن البحث المقتصر على sections سيتجاهله تمامًا. المقاس فعليًا: 26 شجرة library/*/ocr/ مقابل 11 ملف structure.json يسجل "text_source": "ocr". انظر استيعاب المستندات. محتوى موثوق — L2 DAKs، L3 IGs. توجيهات تم البت فيها مسبقًا: مجموعات التكييف الرقمي SMART Digital Adaptation Kits التابعة لمنظمة الصحة العالمية في المستوى L2، وأدلة تطبيق FHIR Implementation Guides في المستوى L3. إن أي توصية تم تبنيها في DAK منشور تُعد دليلاً من نوع مختلف عن الدراسات الأولية — فهي قرار سابق، له أصله ومصدره الخاص وتدريجه الخاص — ويجب الاستشهاد به على هذا النحو. وإن تمريره كدليل أولي هو نمط الفشل الذي وُجد هذا الفصل لمنعه. مستودعات البيانات ومجموعات البيانات الإحصائية. سلاسل المؤشرات والبيانات الدقيقة (microdata). وهي متميزة مجددًا لأن وحدة الدليل هي قياس يرافقه مجتمع وفترة زمنية ومنهجية محددة — وليست مجرد ادعاء نثري.

2556.title: التحقق من الموثوقية، لا مجرد ادعائها
2556.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . تتم مطابقة كل مرشح والتحقق منه مقابل واجهة برمجة التطبيقات القياسية للهيئة التي تنشره، بحيث تكون “الموثوقية” حقيقة مؤكدة بدلاً من أن تكون مجرد ادعاء وارد في اقتباس. ويتم التحقق من أربعة أمور: . | أن المعرّف يُحلّ (resolves) لدى جهة النشر؛ | أن السجل المسترجع يطابق ما يدعيه الاقتباس؛ | أن الإصدار والتاريخ هما المشار إليهما في الاقتباس؛ | أن جهة النشر هي إحدى الجهات التي أعلن هذا الـ folio أنها موثوقة. | . الفحص 2 هو الفحص الذي يكشف الأخطاء الحقيقية؛ إذ يمكن للاقتباس أن يُحلّ تمامًا ومع ذلك لا يقول ما تدعيه الجملة التي تستشهد به. إن الاقتباس غير القابل للحل لا يُسقط ولا يُحتفظ به في صمت. بل يصبح عنصر bean، فتكون الفجوة مرئية بوضوح في خطة العمل بدلاً من أن تبقى كهامش لا يعيد أحد التحقق منه. ما لم يُحسم هنا، وعن عمد: قائمة السجلات، ونقاط النهاية، وشكل سجل الموثوقية المخزن. هذه الحاوية لا تمتلك شبكة اتصالات خارجية، لذا لم يتم التحقق من أي نقطة نهاية تتجاوز مستوى “واجهة برمجة التطبيقات الخاصة بالناشر نفسه”، وتسمية نقاط محددة سيكون مجرد تسجيل للتخمينات. إن هذا شأن يتعلق بالمتطلبات، وهناك عملية منفصلة مخصصة له.

2557.title: تقييم مجمل الأدلة، وتسجيل الفجوات
2557.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . ترتبط الدرجة بـ مجمل الأدلة لسؤال PICO واحد — وهو ما يفسر لماذا يقع التقييم بعد نقطة الالتقاء وليس داخل مسارات التفرع. فالاقتباس الواحد لا يحمل تقييمًا لمستوى اليقين؛ بل مجمل الأدلة التي تجيب عن سؤال هي التي تحمله. ثم بوابة واحدة: هل هذا كافٍ لتقديم توصية؟ . إن عدم كفاية الأدلة يُعد نتيجة. حيث يُسجل كفجوة صريحة يمكن للدليل الإرشادي إعلانها — “الأدلة لا تدعم تقديم توصية هنا” — بدلاً من إغلاقها عن طريق إضعاف التوصية حتى يتصادف أن تدعمها الأدلة المتاحة. ذلك المسلك متاح دائمًا وهو خاطئ دائمًا، ولهذا السبب وُجد للمسار “لا” وجهة يتجه إليها. وفي مسار “نعم”، يتم تدوين نموذج PICO، ومجمل الأدلة المُقيَّم، وكل اقتباس تم التحقق منه مع سجل موثوقيته المحلول، في كتلة التوصية. وبذلك يستطيع القارئ تتبع السلسلة من الجملة رجوعًا إلى المصدر.

2558.title: ما لم يتم بناؤه بعد
2558.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR . كل شيء مذكور أدناه غير موجود، وليس يعمل جزئيًا. المخطط هو نموذج للعملية المقصودة؛ وهذه هي الأجزاء التي لا توجد شفرة برمجية تدعمها. |   | الحالة | . | قائمة السجلات الموثوقة | لم تُقرر بعد | . | روابط واجهات برمجة تطبيقات المراصد | لم تُكتب؛ لم يتم التحقق من أي نقطة نهاية من هذه الحاوية | . | مخطط سجل الموثوقية | لم يُصمم بعد | . | نظام التقييم الذي يعلنه الـ folio | لم يُختر بعد | . | مهارة evidence-retrieval | غير موجودة — المخطط يذكرها بالاسم، ولكن لا يوجد ما ينفذها | . | حقول PICO في كتلة التوصية | غير موجودة في المخطط | . تسمية المخطط لمهارة غير موجودة هو أمر متعمد ويتبع نفس العرف المستخدم في مخططات الاستيعاب: فالنموذج يحدد ما ينبغي أن ينفذ الخطوة، وتكون الفجوة بين النموذج والشفرة البرمجية ظاهرة بدلاً من أن تظل مخفية.

2560.title: Evidence for a recommendation
2560.content: TR… . On this page . | Why this is a subprocess of editing | The subprocess | Step one looks inward | Framing the question as PICO | Three classes of evidence, not one | Verifying authority, not asserting it | Grading the body, and recording a gap | What is not built | . This page is generated from docs/source/process-evidence/ — each section below links to its own source. ✎ Edit QA… TR… . How a recommendation in a guideline gets its evidence — who looks, where they look, and what makes a source authoritative rather than merely cited. STRAWPERSON. The process shape below is real, renders, and passes the workflow policy gate. What is deliberately not settled here: which registries count as trusted, which grading system a folio declares, and how the observatory APIs are bound. A separate process refines requirements; this exists so there is something concrete to refine.

2561.title: Why this is a subprocess of editing
2561.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR… . It runs inside the editing loop, between claiming the bean and drafting the change — see Editing and the HCI validation gate. That position is the whole point: the evidence is gathered before the sentence is written, not assembled afterwards to support one. A recommendation drafted first and evidenced second is a literature search for confirmation. The step order is what makes it not that. It is a call activity, so it has its own file, its own lanes and its own diagram, and the editing diagram stays readable. It also has nothing to do for content that carries no recommendations — a mathematics folio has none — and is skipped there rather than satisfied vacuously.

2562.title: The subprocess
2562.content: ✎ Edit KG… . Four lanes, because four different kinds of actor are involved and conflating them is how accountability gets lost: . | lane | who | owns | . | Author / guideline developer | person | the PICO, the appraisal, the grade | . | Evidence agent | system | retrieval across the three classes | . | Trusted registries and observatories | external | whether a citation resolves | . | Work plan — beans | shared | every gap and every unverified citation | . The third lane is external on purpose. Authority is not something the folio can assert about itself; it is a fact resolved at the publisher. Drawing that lane inside the system boundary would make “authoritative” a self-assessment. BPMN 2.0 source · full-size SVG .

2563.title: Step one looks inward
2563.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR… . The first step looks inward, not outward. Before any search, the author reads what the document, DAK or IG already says on this question. A new recommendation that contradicts a sibling recommendation in the same artefact is a defect that no amount of external evidence will reveal — the sources can all be impeccable and the guideline still incoherent. This is also the cheapest step by far, and it is the one most often skipped.

2564.title: Framing the question as PICO
2564.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR… . Population, Intervention, Comparator, Outcome. WHO guideline development states the question this way before any retrieval, and the reason is auditability rather than ceremony: without a PICO, “we looked for evidence” is not a claim anybody can check. With one, the search is reproducible — a second reader can run it and say whether the same body of evidence comes back. The PICO is carried on the recommendation, not discarded after the search. It is what a later reader needs in order to tell whether new evidence bears on this recommendation or a different one.

2565.title: Three classes of evidence, not one
2565.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR… . Retrieval fans out across three classes that are not interchangeable, and keeping them apart is the point of the parallel gateway: . Trusted sources — L1. Ingested primary literature under library/: the sections/*.md tree and, where a document was scanned, ocr/page-NNN.txt. Known blind spot. A document that was OCR’d but never re-run through pdf-structure.py has only a stub in sections/, so a sections-only search misses it entirely. Measured: 26 library/*/ocr/ trees against 11 structure.json recording "text_source": "ocr". See Document ingestion. Trusted content — L2 DAKs, L3 IGs. Already-adjudicated guidance: WHO SMART Digital Adaptation Kits at L2, FHIR Implementation Guides at L3. A recommendation adopted in a published DAK is evidence of a different kind from a primary study — it is a prior decision, with its own provenance and its own grading — and must be cited as that. Laundering it into primary evidence is the failure mode this separation exists to prevent. Data repositories and statistical datasets. Indicator series and microdata. Distinct again because the unit of evidence is a measurement with a population, a period and a method attached — not a claim in prose.

2566.title: Verifying authority, not asserting it
2566.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR… . Each candidate is resolved against the standard API of the body that publishes it, so that “authoritative” is a resolved fact rather than an assertion in a citation. Four things are checked: . | the identifier resolves at the publisher; | the retrieved record matches what the citation claims; | the version and date are the ones cited; | the publisher is one this folio has declared trusted. | . Check 2 is the one that catches real errors. A citation can resolve perfectly and still not say what the sentence citing it says. An unresolvable citation is neither dropped nor silently kept. It becomes a bean, so the gap is visible in the work plan instead of surviving as a footnote nobody re-checks. Not settled here, and deliberately so: the registry list, the endpoints, and the shape of the stored authority record. This container has no outbound network, so no endpoint below the level of “the publisher’s own API” has been verified, and naming specific ones would be writing down a guess. That is a requirements question, and there is a separate process for it.

2567.title: Grading the body, and recording a gap
2567.content: ✎ Edit QA… TR… . The grade attaches to the body of evidence for one PICO question — which is why appraisal sits after the join and not inside the fan-out. A single citation does not carry a certainty rating; a body of evidence answering a question does. Then one gateway: is this sufficient for a recommendation? . Insufficient evidence is a result. It is recorded as an honest gap the guideline can state — “the evidence does not support a recommendation here” — rather than being closed by weakening the recommendation until the available evidence happens to support it. That move is always available and it is always wrong, which is why the “no” branch has somewhere to go. On the “yes” branch the PICO, the graded body of evidence, and every verified citation with its resolved authority record are written onto the recommendation block. A reader can then retrace the chain from the sentence back to the source.

6343.title: What a folio is made of here
6343.content: A folio is a set of content objects. Each object is a file triple: a typed manifest, a markdown body and, for a formal claim, a Lean sibling. This layer says which kinds of block exist and what each one must carry. Each kind is a node in the block-kinds/ graph with a required profile, so no kind can go unclassified. The document adapter serves structured prose. The paper adapter extends it with the kinds whose assertion is a formal mathematical claim, typeset through LaTeX. The rest of the instance supports that model. validators/ names the checks the code provides, one node per graph typology and schema family. glossary/ holds the content vocabulary. methodologies/ holds the authoring methods a folio draws on. processes/ holds the executable BPMN diagrams for the authoring and review work. skills/ holds the instructions an agent loads to carry that work out.

6344.title: The rule this layer turns on
6344.content: This repository is the platform, not the content. A folio’s chapters, constants and vocabularies live in that folio’s own repository. If you are about to write subject matter here, you are either in the wrong repository or writing something that belongs in a folio as data. The instance’s README sets out the scope boundary in full, along with what is still pre-split.

It declares NO cat-harness.processes:adjudication codes on purpose, and that absence is the whole of bean bvuk. This step used to name three — stands, scope, dispensation — and six diagrams called it: review-narrative and voice-review, whose question those three answer, and four whose question they do not. refresh-materialized asks which side wins a local-vs-remote conflict; there is no criterion to scope there and no dispensation to grant, yet the outcome half ran regardless. Since the caller's question decides the permitted answers, the caller declares them: cat-harness.processes:adjudication codes on its OWN call activity, with its own gateway acting on them. criterion-adjudication.bpmn is that for the QA-criterion question. What could NOT be fixed by passing the codes as data, which was this bean's first recommendation: the three branches ran three different TASKS, so a caller handed local-wins would have had it pointing at A_ScopeCriterion. Permitted answers (bean bvuk, owner 2026-09-23): stands — the finding is right and the author addresses it; withdrawn — the finding is wrong and the comment closes. Recorded on the comment, not branched: either way the flow goes on to the coverage check. The register is wrong for this block (fix the prose); the rule does not apply to this content (scope it on the voice, one edit rather than ten overrules); or the rule applies and this block is an exception (a reviewer entry saying why). Adjudication candidate, extracted folio-assistant's adjudication: the adjudication leads, the checker's entry is kept, and the dispensation carries its reason. Reviewers disagreeing on ONE criterion is a criterion disagreement, so this calls the QA-criterion specialisation (bean bvuk, owner 2026-09-23): the failing entry stands, the criterion does not apply to this screen, or a dispensation is granted with its reason. FOR THIS CALLER THE SPLIT WAS A REGRESSION, not a fix, and that is worth keeping because the PR that made it said the opposite. When bvuk moved the outcome half out of adjudication.bpmn, #1074 reported that all four remaining callers "no longer reach A_ScopeCriterion or A_Dispensation" and framed it as the intended effect. True for three of them, whose question never admitted those steps. Here it removed the two steps the sentence above already documents, so the call was left pointing at a shared judgement that no longer runs either. Repointing restores what the documentation always claimed rather than changing it. The entry condition matches exactly rather than approximately: GW_Agree asks whether the blind reviewers' entries agree and takes no here, and Process_CriterionAdjudication starts at "entries for one criterion disagree" — R_Review records pass, warn or fail PER CRITERION with a reason, so the disagreement reaching this step is a per-criterion disagreement between reviewer entries and nothing else. Admit it to the train, record the train id candidate, extracted Writes the queue entry's trainId and placement (rule, class, rank) with who decided and when. A decision, so it is stored; the facts it was decided on are not. PRECONDITION, CHECKED RATHER THAN ASSUMED: the worktree carries no untracked, non-ignored file before the member is merged and the tree regenerated. git status --porcelain must be empty. The reason is specific: generated directory READMEs carry a per-subdirectory file count, and the writer counts the files GIT WOULD COMMIT -- git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard (bootstrap-tools/scripts/git-files.ts:23). --exclude-standard already keeps IGNORED junk out, which is the __pycache__ case that drove that line, but --others still counts an untracked file nobody has ignored. So a transient written by an earlier train step moves a committed count, readme:subgraphs:check goes red, and the red belongs to nobody. Train 6 hit this. The count is volatile for a second reason the precondition cannot fix: two members each adding a file write different integers to one line. Measured in bean y7b3 -- 76 of 300 replayed merges conflicted on beans/README.md, every one on the | defs/ | N files | line -- and the exposure is wider than that bean states: 54 generated READMEs across 14 instances carry 207 such rows (measured 2026-10-02). merge:main already resolves them (readme-generated-regions), so the cost falls on merges made by plain git. The chosen fix is bean ba9e: take the integer off main into the KG's _data layer, which classifies take-base and is therefore auto-resolved, leaving the README with a marker that is invariant until the directory crosses LIST_LIMIT. Not done here -- it spans the pinned bootstrap-tools submodule. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/merge-train.bpmn#Task_Admit . The publication manager rather than the editor because a pin is not a change to the corpus — it is a change to what the published artefact is BUILT FROM, and that role is the one accountable for what is live. Deliberately NOT a DMN-backed gateway. Every computed gateway in this repository reduces to arithmetic over tool output; this one weighs a rendering nobody can score against the cost of staying behind, and a table here would look authoritative without being so. People agree the requirements there, and the committee or editor changes the record with cs-add / cs-remove / cs-title / cs-requirements / cs-committee / cs-merge / cs-split / cs-close / cs-new. The three loops back into A_Implement (increment rejected, MVP not ready, feedback translated) re-enter implementation on the SAME branch, and re-announcing on each would be noise. Build the entry [tree + manifest] candidate, extracted First the working copy is produced (qa:refresh, bean 3hk4): while the checkout still tracks test/results/, the commit's own copy is the record and nothing runs; once it does not, every declared QA writer runs into the empty tree, because the gates are in judge mode and wrote nothing a publish could carry. A refresh that leaves a writer failed, a family empty or a file unclaimed is INCOMPLETE: the job goes red and qa:publish --completeness refuses, so a partial tree is never stored as the commit's record — the "Not stored" outcome, reached before any push. Then it hashes the working copy of every declared qa directory (<instance>/test/results/**, byte-identical to the checkout's layout) into a tree through a private index, and writes manifest.json (qa-reports-manifest/v1): inputs, producers, verdict counts and the gates' result. A methodology is adopted because it is somebody else's named, external work; this step checks that the origin it cites resolves to a source in a declared library, and reads the methodology-evidence QA sidecar for it. A source that was reachable when the methodology was adopted can stop being so, and a methodology adopted before this axis existed was never checked at all. Measured 2026-09-22: six methodologies cited an origin and NONE had that source in any library, so every selection made until then rested on an unverifiable citation. WHAT A GAP DOES AND DOES NOT DO. A missing source does NOT block the decision, and this step has no branch that stops the process — that would make a documentation gap into an outage, and the owner decides whether an unbacked methodology may still be used. It does two things: it runs literature-search to try to close the gap, and it puts the evidence state into the record A_Record writes, so a reader can tell a decision made on a verified method from one made on a citation nobody could follow. The third state is the one that matters. "Source ingested", "source located but unreachable from here" and "no source found" are three different facts, and literature-search exists largely to stop the middle one being reported as the last. It is an override somebody applied to get to green, and nobody can review it afterwards — which is why this step is not relaxable. They were four jobs (lean-bare-import, python-imports, rust-wildcard, dependency-advisories), each about a second of work behind a ~13 s checkout and a runner request; measured on main run 37133247484 (2026-10-03), the run took 21.7 min while its longest job executed for 174 s, the rest waiting for runners. Now they are steps of the hygiene job, and every step after the first gate runs if: !cancelled(), so a red one masks none of the others — the om30 rule kept inside one job rather than by splitting it. (1) Lean, HARD: fail on any bare import Mathlib in content/**/*.lean; in this platform repo there is no content/, so the step prints SKIP and states that nothing was scanned. (2) Python, HARD: ruff F401 (unused) and F403 (wildcard) over the Python trees that exist, then the Python tests; an absent tree is dropped rather than passed to ruff, and an empty set says SKIP. 6465.title: J
6465.content: Judge domain correctness of worked case or indicator cohort candidate, extracted Performed by the human SME in Lane_SME (clinical-sme, judgementOnly: true). The SME inspects the worked case (for decision support) or the cohort and expected vs computed value (for an indicator definition) and renders a domain verdict (pass, fail, or needs-revision) with rationale. Deliberately carries no skill reference: no procedure yields the answer, which is the whole reason a person is in this lane. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/sme-test-data-review.bpmn#Task_SmeJudge . Judge the assets in their design candidate, extracted A person looks at the ingested assets laid out in the design they are for, at BOTH a web and a mobile width. THIS IS A HUMAN STEP INSIDE INGESTION, and that is stated rather than hidden: ingest-theme.bpmn used to refuse to call this process for exactly that reason. The owner's ruling puts theme review at ingestion only, and a ruling that moves a review does not remove the person who performs it — so ingestion of a THEME SOURCE is attended at this step, while ingestion of everything else stays unattended because Gateway_ThemeSource routes it past. A judgement made at one viewport is incomplete, not passed, and the wireframe of the surface (wireframe-design-review) says what each layout was meant to be. Three defects in the landing board — a selector matching nothing, a crop cutting the subject, a fade wrong in both directions — were invisible to a clean build, a passing suite and every gate, and were found only by rendering the page and looking. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/ui/theme-ui-review.bpmn#R_Judge .

6466.content: Keep it as a trial: the unpublished trashcan candidate, extracted A trial goes to the kept trashcan: addressable, exported, never published. Its node declares $schema: folio-fsh-guts/v1 and carries the bean or issue it was written under, since it was never moved from anywhere and a movedFrom would be invented provenance. It is NOT refreshed: a trial records what the source looked like when it was tried. Promoting a trial means running this process again with permanent = yes, so the gates are asked afresh. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/sample-import.bpmn#Task_Trial . Keep the local edit, and re-pin so it stops being asked candidate, extracted The local edit wins, so nothing is re-materialized — and the pin moves to the upstream revision that was compared against. Re-pinning is the half that is easy to forget and is the reason this is a step rather than an absence: without it the same upstream change is detected as new on every cycle, and a contributor is asked the same settled question for ever. The record says the copy is deliberately divergent FROM a named revision, which is a different claim from being stale against an unknown one. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/refresh-materialized.bpmn#Task_KeepLocal .

6468.content: Make sure every step is done candidate, extracted Following a harness's instructions once is not the same as every step being done. complete-initialization walks the steps the declarations name — FIRST the harness's JSON Schemas and JSON-LD at the IRIs they name, the primary step of initializing a Knowledge Graph harness; then declared directories, assets, the README and its sections, and the site that carries the documents — checks each, does what can be done, asks the person for what only they can do, and reports every step in its state. Make sure gh-pages exists and Pages serves it candidate, extracted Provisioning the target, owned by this Tool's subprocess rather than by the general step (owner, 2026-10-01: "need to create gh-pages branch before can turn on"). In order: (1) an orphan gh-pages branch exists — git ls-remote --heads origin gh-pages; if absent, push a placeholder (index.html + .nojekyll); (2) Pages is on, Source = the gh-pages branch at / — gh api -X POST repos/<o>/<r>/pages -f source[branch]=gh-pages -f source[path]=/ when gh is signed in, otherwise the exact manual step (Settings → Pages → Deploy from a branch → gh-pages, / (root)). Options analysis accept · revise · discard candidate, extracted On the edge out of Task_ReviewFindings and before Task_RecordDecision: the findings are the evidence, so the options can only be weighed once they exist, and after Task_RecordDecision the decision is already written down. NOT between Gateway_EditorDecision and Task_RecordDecision, which is the pair the work-plan named — in this diagram those run the OTHER WAY ROUND. Flow_21b goes Task_RecordDecision -> Gateway_EditorDecision, so the gateway reads a decision that has already been recorded, and interposing there would analyse options after the choice was made. In the Agent lane, and this diagram makes the reason sharp. Task_RecordDecision is a userTask in Lane_Editor that already names decision-audit, and Process_OptionsAnalysis ends with its own decision-audit note. Those are two different acts — the subprocess records that the options were WEIGHED, the editor records WHAT WAS CHOSEN — and putting the analysis in the editor's lane would collapse them, making the same party both analyse and decide. The subprocess's own documentation refuses that: it produces options and a recommendation, and the authorisation belongs to the calling step. CallActivity_Evidence sits in Lane_Editor instead, and that is not an inconsistency: the author performs the evidence retrieval, whereas here the point is that the analyst is not the decider. On the trigger: A_Frame opens the subprocess on opening-brief's trigger — irreversibility and surprise — and leaving there is a correct outcome. A spelling fix that reached Task_ReviewFindings with one mechanical finding exits immediately; a revise-or-discard on a block other content depends on does not. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/editing-hci-validation.bpmn#Call_OptionsAnalysis . Options analysis adopt · hold · decline candidate, extracted On the single edge into PM_Decide, and deliberately not earlier: the MVP build and its gates are HOW the options' costs are measured, so an analysis before Task_Mvp would weigh alternatives against no evidence. Everything the decider needs exists by the time the reviewer has finished and the fixable findings are fixed. In the Agent lane, because this step produces the analysis and does not make the decision — PM_Decide is a userTask whose lane admits person only, and putting the analysis in the agent's lane is what keeps that separation legible rather than implied. A subprocess that decided would be a second accepting party. Reached through the loop as well as straight through: SF_UA_8 re-enters at A_Impact, so a run where the reviewer found something fixable arrives here a second time with different evidence. That is a genuine re-analysis and its op="note" appends rather than deduping, which is the behaviour wanted — a second note records that the options were weighed again against changed inputs. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/sdlc/upstream-version-adoption.bpmn#Call_OptionsAnalysis . Options analysis how to absorb the impact candidate, extracted On the edge OUT of Task_AssessImpact and before Task_CommitPush, because the impact assessment is the evidence the options are weighed against. An analysis before it would compare ways of absorbing a downstream effect nobody has measured yet; one after the commit would be a rationalisation of a choice already pushed. NOT between Task_AssessImpact and Task_ReviewImpact, although that is the handoff the work-plan named. Those two tasks are in DIFFERENT LANES with no sequence flow between them — the agent's assessment reaches the committee through Task_CompareBeforeAfter, not directly — so there was no edge there to interpose on. The conceptual handoff is real; the edge was not. In the Agent lane, matching upstream-version-adoption: this step produces the options and their trade-offs, and GW_Approved in the Review Committee lane is where a decision is taken. A subprocess in the reviewer's lane would read as the committee analysing its own options, which is a different process. On the trigger: reaching this call is not the same as running the whole of it. Process_OptionsAnalysis opens with A_Frame, whose trigger is opening-brief's — irreversibility and surprise, not size — and leaving at that first activity is a correct outcome rather than a skipped step. A copy-edit exits immediately; a logic change that moves an indicator does not, and this is the diagram where that distinction has teeth, since Task_EditLogic feeds straight into the assessment. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/content-change-review.bpmn#Call_OptionsAnalysis . Options analysis how to implement candidate, extracted On the single edge from Start_Process_CRDM_Deliver into A_Implement, so the approach is chosen before any code exists. By Phase 6 the needs, requirements and data model are signed off, which is exactly the evidence an options analysis needs and the reason it belongs here rather than earlier: at Call_Needs there is nothing to weigh, and after A_Implement the choice has been made in code. Note where this is NOT. The work-plan named crdm-requirements-workflow, and A_Implement is not in that diagram — crdm-requirements.bpmn is the orchestrator, seven call activities and a gateway, and Phase 6 lives here in crdm-deliver.bpmn. The call goes where the step is, not where the plan said to look. The three loop-backs into A_Implement — _5 (increment rejected), _7 (MVP not ready), _13 (feedback translated) — deliberately BYPASS this call. Routing them through it would run the subprocess on every iteration of the inner loop, which is the ceremony this design refuses: a gate invoked on every pass stops being read. An iteration reworks an approach already chosen; if the APPROACH is what is wrong, that is not a loop iteration and it belongs to the calling step in crdm-requirements.bpmn. Contrast upstream-version-adoption, where the loop DOES re-enter the analysis. There the loop-back returns to A_Impact, which re-gathers the evidence, so the second pass weighs genuinely different inputs. Here the loop returns to implementation with the evidence unchanged. A_Implement carries a note on the bean (its claim is the OPEN that Process_CRDM calls first); this step carries no bean op, because Process_OptionsAnalysis ends with its own decision-audit note on the bean the caller claimed. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/process/crdm-deliver.bpmn#Call_OptionsAnalysis . 6471.content: P1.1 · Agree purpose, datasets, period, duties and trust anchors candidate, extracted The parties agree the purpose, the datasets, the period, the conditions and duties, which trust anchors each side accepts, and the legal basis the sharing rests on (consent, treatment, public-health law or a research waiver). This sets what the text must say; it is a negotiation between people. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_AgreeTerms . P1.2 · Write the legal text [document-authoring] candidate, extracted Write the agreement as a document folio: one normative statement per clause the parties must keep, through normative-statements. The text says which governs if it and a machine-readable form disagree (suggested: the text). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_WriteText . P1.2a · Record the legal basis [normative-statements] candidate, extracted The text states the legal basis the parties agreed in P1.1 as a normative statement: consent, treatment, public-health law, or a research waiver. Consent rule 1: only an agreement whose legal basis is consent carries the odrl:obtainConsent duty; treatment, public-health law and research waivers do not rest on consent. The gateway that follows, the ODRL and the reviewers all read the basis from this statement. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_RecordLegalBasis . P1.2b · Draft the plain-language summary [document-authoring] candidate, extracted Consent-based only. Write a plain-language summary of the agreement in the same document folio: what it lets the recipient do with the person's data, in words the person can read. Consent rule 3: every agreement that needs consent publishes this summary, hashed with the agreement (P2.2a), and the summary is what the person consents to. It is reviewed, rendered and versioned with the text. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_PlainSummary . P1.3 · Derive the ODRL 2.2 Agreement candidate, extracted Computable only. One assigner and one assignee (ODRL 2.2 §2.1.3), permissions and prohibitions with target assets (§2.2), constraints (§2.5.1) and duties (§2.6.3), written as JSON-LD. Purposes from HL7 PurposeOfUse. Consent rule 1: the Agreement carries the odrl:obtainConsent duty only when the legal basis recorded in P1.2a is consent. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_DeriveOdrl . P1.4 · Check the ODRL against the text [content-review] candidate, extracted Computable only. A person checks that the ODRL says what the text says, and signs it off. A program can check the ODRL is well formed; it cannot check that it matches the text. The check includes the consent duty: present when the legal basis is consent, absent otherwise (consent rule 1). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_CheckOdrl . P1.5 · Split public terms from private annexes candidate, extracted Split the agreement into a public template and private annexes (security controls, named staff). Only the hash of a private annex is ever published. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_SplitAnnexes . P1.6 · Sign candidate, extracted The signatories sign: wet ink, or an electronic signature under national law. Technically a detached JWS (RFC 7515) or CMS (RFC 5652); PAdES for a signed PDF needs the owner's approval. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Sign . P14.2 · Decide what happens to existing grants candidate, extracted Existing grants keep citing the old hash. The parties decide, per agreement: they stay valid until expiry, or they are revoked and reissued against the new version (in smart-trust). The old version stays readable. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_DecideGrants . P14.3 · Record that new consent is needed candidate, extracted The amendment widens use, so a Consent citing the old version's URL and hash does not cover the new version (consent rule 2). Record on the bean, and in the new version's text, that new consent is needed; the new version gets its own plain-language summary (P1.2b). Asking each person again is the trust layer's. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_NewConsentNeeded . P14.5 · Set the catalogue status to ended [dsa-catalogue-status] candidate, extracted Set the life-cycle status of the agreement's DCAT 3 record (DCAT 3 §6.4.30). The published versions stay readable at their URLs. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_SetStatus . P2.1 · Assign the version and its immutable URL [content-publish] candidate, extracted Each signed version gets its own immutable URL (for example /dsa/42/v3). A 'latest' URL may exist; nothing cites it. A new version never overwrites an old one. This fixed-version URL is the one a Consent cites (consent rule 2), and a computable agreement's ODRL policy uid is set to it (P2.3). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_AssignVersion . P2.2 · Record the SHA-256 of each file [dsa-checksum] candidate, extracted Compute SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) of the signed text, and of the ODRL file if there is one, recorded as DCAT 3 spdx:checksum and verified by check:dsa-hash. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_Hash . P2.2a · Hash the plain-language summary with the agreement [dsa-checksum] candidate, extracted Consent-based only. Record the SHA-256 of the plain-language summary beside the agreement's, in the same version (consent rule 3). The summary a person consented to can then be checked against the agreement it summarises; a changed summary is a new version. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_HashSummary . P2.2b · State the fixed-version URL and hash a Consent cites [content-publish] candidate, extracted Consent-based only. The version's publication metadata states the fixed-version URL (P2.1) and the hash (P2.2) that a Consent cites in FHIR R4 Consent.policy.uri (consent rule 2), never the 'latest' URL. For a computable agreement that URL is also the ODRL policy uid (P2.3): a Consent counts only when its Consent.policy.uri equals the agreement's ODRL policy uid, so the two are the same string. BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_ConsentCitation . P2.3 · Make the ODRL cite the text by URL and hash [dsa-odrl-source] candidate, extracted The ODRL policy names the signed text distribution with dcterms:source (DCMI Terms), pointing at the immutable URL whose spdx:checksum was just recorded. Its uid is that same fixed-version URL, the URL a Consent cites in Consent.policy.uri (consent rule 2). BPMN activities of folio-assistant-core · source folio-assistant-core/processes/content/dsa-document-lifecycle.bpmn#Task_OdrlCitesText . P2.4–5 · Write the DCAT 3 record and link versions [dsa-dcat-record] candidate, extracted One DCAT 3 record: the agreement as a catalogued resource, each file a dcat:Distribution with dcat:downloadURL and spdx:checksum; datasets it covers carry odrl:hasPolicy. Versions are linked with DCAT 3 versioning (previous version, version, current version). A package is an addressable set — the JSON-LD, the assets it references, and a manifest naming every file with its digest and byte count. The loop is the phase: a needs statement nobody confirmed is an agent's summary, not a requirement. Phase 4a: Compare the viable options candidate, extracted Phase 4 often ends with a CHOICE rather than a plan, and this is the step that hands it over. Per option: what it does, its pro, its con, what it changes DOWNSTREAM, and how reversible it is — laid out where the rows can be read against each other, then one recommendation and a stated default. A step of its own rather than a line inside A_DefineReqs, because it has a different output and a different reader: the impact analysis is for the record, the comparison is the thing the BA answers from. Folding it in is how it gets skipped — the analysis feels finished, so the options go over as a list of names. Place it in uploads/ by a declared route [upload-routes] candidate, extracted THE FIRST LINK, and it did not exist until 2026-09-30. Everything downstream of here takes a file that is already in the queue, and both ingest Tools type their first input as "The upload to ingest, under the declared uploads graph". So the act of PUTTING it there was performed by three different mechanisms and governed by none of them. WHAT THIS STEP IS. The basic flow's ACCEPT step: choosing an arrival route, writing the bytes into the declared queue of the instance that will own them, and discharging what that route does not discharge for you. The routes, what each writer owes, and the two that are mechanisms against the one that is a persona are in the upload-routes skill; upload-url composes the forge URL for the web route from the declaration rather than from a literal, because a hand-written one 404'd. WHY A PLAIN bpmn:task AND NOT A userTask. A userTask asserts a human performs it, and this lane is named "Contributor (human or agent)" precisely because both do — measured over this repository's own history, files have reached uploads/ in commits authored by Carl Leitner and in commits authored by Claude. Asserting human-only here would be the activity-fulfilment-kind contradiction written deliberately: the diagram saying one thing and the lane's role graph another. A plain task asserts nothing about the performer, which is the truth. WHY THE BEAN OP IS note AND NOT claim. Placing a file claims nothing; it adds to a queue. What it owes the work plan is visibility — three batches of PDFs arrived through the forge's web UI (c8349950fa5, f4ddfc65c8d, b8549160bb1) with no bean, no PR and no note, and the first sibling to notice was a generator going stale. 6472.title: Q
6472.content: QA working copy, built once (NOT A GATE) candidate, extracted Bean jtfk, issue #2456. bun run qa:working-copy (bean 72a8) — the bootstrap kg-export, then every declared QA writer — used to run INSIDE each job that reads the QA tree, and qa-publish ran the same writers again: nine builds of one tree from one commit, measured at 2,284 of 4,714 runner-seconds (48 %) on run 37659324493. Now the qa-working-copy job builds it once and uploads everything the build changed as an artifact with a sha256 manifest; each reader downloads it, checks the manifest against the hash this job reported and every restored file against the manifest, and only then judges. An artifact rather than a cache, because a cache key built from less than the real inputs serves stale data; an artifact is per run and exact. It judges nothing, so it is not a gate and does not reach GW_Join; a failed build fails every reader at its first step (they run if: !cancelled()), never a skip. Drawn feeding GW_Readers, the four tasks that wait for it; within them typescript-static and gates-standalone read no QA tree and do not wait, and qa-publish waits for it as well as for Task_RepositoryGates. The exception is NOT "these actors may skip the rule"; it is "say what you did". A writer that updates the digest alongside the bytes passes, and the record then describes what is actually there. BPMN activities of who-iris · source who-iris/processes/iris-cdn-nightly.bpmn#Task_Review . Review the schema definition node candidate, extracted Does the node declare what KIND of node it is? Does a widened type carry its mirrors? Does a removed field leave a reason behind, so the next author does not re-add it in good faith? And where the node RENDERS to something the site serves — a colour, a glyph, a theme's tokens — does a Tool maintain that artefact, and does the visual fact have only one home? The node decides; the stylesheet reports. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/kg/review-code.bpmn#Task_ReviewSchema . The reviewer reads the staged page and the before/after; for a figure or table, the visual-diff picture and its changed-pixel count; for a form, the wireframe (wireframe-design-review; at L3 its Questionnaire follows fhir-questionnaire-wireframe). What to judge per component is the skill l2-component-edit-review's column "the reviewer judges". BPMN activities of fhir-harness · source fhir-harness/processes/content/questionnaire-wireframe-review.bpmn#Task_ReviewStaged . A skill can be served by the neighbours of its mechanism while the mechanism itself is reachable from no node, and check:tools reports it as covered and is right to. BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/content/review-narrative.bpmn#Task_ReviewTranslation . Review translated content for completeness candidate, extracted The asset carries no description. BPMN activities of smart-base · source smart-base/processes/content/SGAuthoring.DAKLifecycle.bpmn#Task_ReviewTranslatedContent . BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/human-translation-workflow.bpmn#Task_SMEReview . Shown whole, because a reader who sees only what was chosen cannot tell "not offered" from "not taken". BPMN activities of cat-harness · source cat-harness/processes/library/subscribe-kg.bpmn#Task_Review .
